text: 人到了40岁左右会逐渐开始往内寻求，去发现内在真实的自己。
en: People around the age of 40 will gradually begin to seek inward, to discover their true inner self.

text: 开始思考活着的意义？
en: Begin to ponder the meaning of being alive?

text: 我是谁？
en: Who am I?

text: 工作的意义？
en: The meaning of work?

text: 我在为谁而活？
en: For whom am I living?

text: 我想过什么样的生活？
en: What kind of life do I wish to live?

text: 我是否可以做一些自己真正想做的事情…
en: Can I do some things I truly want to do...

text: 按照人的心理发展来讲，用分析心理学的荣格的话来讲，这是每个人心理上的正常需要，荣格把它称之为一种自性化的需要。
en: In terms of human psychological development, to use the words of Jung of analytical psychology, this is a normal psychological need of every person; Jung called it a need for individuation.

text: 醒来，唉，我还活着。
en: Wake up, alas, I am still alive.

text: 你们这些二十几岁的孩子却很有可能在到30岁的时候死去。
en: Yet you young people in your twenties are very likely to have died by the time you reach thirty.

text: 已经步入了40的年龄，我的体会是“过往不咎，一路向阳”，到了不惑年龄，似乎对很多外界物质乃至名利都不那么看中，相反更多是内心的自洽和平静。
en: Having entered my forties, my experience is "let bygones be bygones, always facing the sun"; having reached the age of no confusion, I seem to care less about many external material things and even fame and gain, and instead find more inner self-consistency and peace.

text: 今年经历了至亲离世，健康亮红灯，家人疾病，大环境影响等，感觉世事无常，突然对很多事情失去兴趣，其实人，短暂一生，什么也带不走，你所拥有的只有时间，所以更珍惜当下的每分每秒。
en: This year I experienced the passing of a close loved one, health warnings, family illness and the impact of the broader environment, among other things; I felt the impermanence of the world and suddenly lost interest in many things. In truth, a person, in this brief life, can take nothing with them; all you possess is time, so I treasure all the more every minute and second of the present.

text: 对过往复盘，为了40后的人生顺风顺水，与你分享，期待对你帮助。
en: In reviewing the past, so that life after forty may go smoothly, I share with you, hoping it will help you.

text: 从生涯咨询师到裸辞创业，一晃10年有余，今年是我创业的第7年半，脱离职场高管的光环，恍如隔世，这七年多，跌宕起伏，经历过低谷，高峰，也是成长加速的7年，在不断调整后获得持续向上发展。
en: From a career consultant to quitting my job to start a business, in the blink of an eye more than ten years have passed; this year marks my seventh and a half years of entrepreneurship. Having left behind the halo of a corporate executive, it feels like a different life. These seven-plus years have been full of ups and downs, with troughs and peaks, and have also been seven years of accelerated growth, achieving sustained upward development through continuous adjustment.

text: 每年年末，我会有一个习惯，对于当年复盘，来年去进行展望，以便新的一年走的更加笃定和从容。
en: Every year at its end, I have a habit of reviewing the year and looking ahead to the next, so that the new year may be met with greater conviction and composure.

text: 我也愿意将我的复盘分享给你，希望帮助你迎接崭新的2025年。
en: I am also willing to share my review with you, hoping to help you welcome the brand-new year of 2025.

text: 为什么而做
en: Why I do it

text: 身为一位生涯顾问机构的创始人，除了高管赋能教练以及企业OD&领导力顾问的身份，同时在我有余力的情况下，在赵默的公众号笔耕不辍，
en: As the founder of a career advisory organisation, apart from my roles as an executive empowerment coach and corporate OD & leadership consultant, and whenever I have the spare capacity, I keep writing diligently on Mo Zhao's official account,

text: 也有幸被海天出版社邀约出版《跨越式成长思维》，深度研究和拆解过往5000多起案例，萃取成为深度的案例解决文章，截止到当下已经1059篇，
en: I was also fortunate to be invited by Haitian Publishing House to publish "Leapfrog Growth Mindset", deeply researching and deconstructing over 5,000 past cases and distilling them into in-depth case-resolution articles; as of now there are already 1,059 pieces,

text: 每一篇背后是挑灯夜战和呕心之作，不断推陈出新，创造了很多创新的案例作品，有学员问我，你为什么那么忙，还要持续要花大量时间去研究生涯发展咨询？
en: Behind each piece lies burning the midnight oil and painstaking work; constantly bringing forth the new, I have created many innovative case works. A student asked me, why are you so busy yet still spend a great deal of time researching career development consultation?

text: 不觉得累吗？
en: Don't you feel tired?

text: 研究的过程是很清苦的，这背后完全依靠内在的热爱， 2024年是一个不平凡的一年，我经历了至亲离去，疾病， 企业顾问服务消减等一系列的挫折，
en: The process of research is austere and solitary; it relies entirely on inner passion. The year 2024 was an extraordinary one; I experienced the loss of close loved ones, illness, a reduction in corporate consultancy services and a series of other setbacks,

text: 我仿佛坠进了无边的深渊，每天都生活在黑暗里，似乎看不到光明，但是多年积累，不断慕名前来的来访者给我带来了希望，我花了大量的时间沉浸在高管发展咨询中，
en: I seemed to fall into a boundless abyss, living in darkness every day, seemingly unable to see the light; yet through years of accumulation, the clients who kept coming drawn by my reputation brought me hope, and I spent a great deal of time immersed in executive development consultation,

text: 我看到了想要获得但是有心无力的苦，我看到了缺少坐标认不清方向的苦，我还看到了持续上进缺少希望的苦，是啊，只有亲身经历过的人才能切身感受，
en: I saw the suffering of those who want to attain something yet lack the strength to do so; I saw the suffering of those who lack a frame of reference and cannot recognise their direction; I also saw the suffering of those who keep striving yet lack hope. Indeed, only those who have experienced it themselves can truly feel it,

text: 我看到了成长过程中不得不面对的苦，但是如果有人可以帮你走出深渊，这将大大缩短你沉浸其中的时间。
en: I saw the suffering one inevitably must face in the process of growth; but if someone can help you walk out of the abyss, this will greatly shorten the time you spend immersed in it.

text: 我开始懂得，咨询是需要一生的时间去修炼，不仅是学识的修炼，也是自我的修炼，当你可以自我度过劫难，你的能量会不断提升，不断提升的能量，继而又可以帮助他人去超越职业发展的苦，你也渐渐用一个生命去影响另外一个生命。
en: I began to understand that consultation is something that requires a lifetime to cultivate — not only the cultivation of knowledge, but also the cultivation of the self. When you can overcome calamity by yourself, your energy will keep rising; this ever-rising energy, in turn, can help others transcend the suffering of career development, and you gradually influence another life with your own life.

text: 所以，为了什么而做，不是为了小我，而是帮助一个个困局的他我，去成为真正的自己。
en: So, why do I do it? Not for the small self, but to help the many trapped other-selves become their true selves.

text: 我是谁
en: Who am I

text: 那么我是谁？
en: Then who am I?

text: 很明显，你是一位有着14年经验的资深高管发展教练和企业OD顾问，没错，是我的外在身份，可是教练背后的本质是谁呢？
en: Clearly, you are a senior executive development coach and corporate OD consultant with fourteen years of experience; yes, that is my external identity, but who is the essence behind the coach?

text: 在我看来，直到当下，我一直对生涯教练职业怀有敬畏之心，即使深耕了十多年，体系和专业都非常健全，但是在持续咨询工作中，越是感受到自己的渺小，
en: In my view, to this day I have always held a sense of awe towards the career-coaching profession; even though I have delved deeply for over ten years and both my system and expertise are very sound, in ongoing consultancy work I feel all the more keenly my own smallness,

text: 很多时候，不是单一的技术就可以解决，而是大量的糅合过往的经验，以及哲学，心理，动力学等多学科的系统方法论，并且倾注大量时间去探索，
en: Much of the time, it is not a single technique that can solve it, but rather a great deal of blending of past experience together with systematic methodologies drawn from multiple disciplines such as philosophy, psychology and dynamics, and pouring in a great deal of time to explore,

text: 而且时代在变化，对应解决方案也要不断结合时代去创新，更为重要的是，你需要持续用爱的能量去感化，去让他们感受到源源不断的动力，
en: Moreover, as the times change, the corresponding solutions must also be continually innovated in line with the era; more importantly, you need to persistently use the energy of love to move them, so that they feel an unceasing drive,

text: 构建对未来的希望。
en: and build hope for the future.

text: 所以，我是谁，更多的是一位持续钻研的助人者，很有幸截至当下已经帮助5300多位瓶颈的人走出苦难，开启全新的自我。
en: So, who am I? More than anything, I am a persistent, devoted helper; I am fortunate that, as of now, I have helped more than 5,300 people stuck at a bottleneck walk out of their suffering and open up a brand-new self.

text: 如何做？
en: How to do it?

text: 即将过去的2024年里，我帮助了5家企业开展年度顾问&领导力培训，在企业变革的时刻，优化了组织设计，同时展开了系统的降本增效方案，为企业卸掉重负，轻装上阵。
en: In the soon-to-pass year of 2024, I helped five enterprises carry out annual consultancy & leadership training; at the moment of corporate transformation, I optimised the organisational design and simultaneously launched a systematic plan to reduce costs and improve efficiency, lightening the burden for enterprises so they could travel light.

text: 同时2024年采取断舍离，摆脱过往密集咨询的模式，以深度咨询服务，帮助了100+CEO高管朋友在企业线下团体和个体系统多次咨询陪伴下，实现发展瓶颈的破除，看到未来清晰的方向。
en: At the same time, in 2024 I adopted a philosophy of letting go, breaking away from the previous model of intensive consultation, and through in-depth consultancy services helped over 100 CEO executive friends, under the repeated consultancy companionship of corporate offline groups and individual systems, break through their development bottlenecks and see a clear direction for the future.

text: 但是随着咨询的不断增加，我发现我的时间越来越有限，在不影响咨询品质的情况下，我做出了两项决定，一方面培训后续的新手咨询师，
en: But as consultations kept increasing, I found my time ever more limited; without affecting the quality of consultation, I made two decisions. On the one hand, I train up-and-coming novice consultants,

text: 成为未来细分领域的专家，2024年6月，5位期待成为未来的导师，去帮助他们成为实战的咨询师，另外一方面，开启了线下围炉午话以及两日的自我探索深度工坊，
en: to become experts in future niche fields; in June 2024, five who aspire to become future mentors, to help them become practical consultants. On the other hand, I launched offline fireside noon talks and two-day deep workshops for self-exploration,

text: 萃取过往十年几千起团体和个案，小班10人团体顾问的形式，去实现认知，潜能，领导力，以及平衡的突破，今年累积开设4期，获得了近60人的认可。
en: Distilling a decade of thousands of group and individual cases, in the form of small-group consultancy of ten people, to achieve breakthroughs in cognition, potential, leadership and balance; this year I have run four cohorts in total and earned the recognition of nearly sixty people.

text: 新的一年，我会依旧研修营和深度咨询的模式，同时授之以渔，实实在在帮助他们成为未来细分领域的专家，从而实现有更多助人者的愿望。
en: In the new year, I will continue with the model of study camps and deep consultation, and at the same time teach them to fish, genuinely helping them become experts in future niche fields, thus fulfilling the wish to have more helpers.

text: 以上是我2024年的复盘，期待2025年继续不忘初心，在咨询匠人的道路上走得更稳，成为持续践行的长期主义者，那么你的2024年复盘是什么？
en: The above is my review of 2024; I look forward to 2025, staying true to my original aspiration, walking more steadily on the path of the consultancy craftsperson, and becoming a long-termist who perseveres in practice. So, what is your review of 2024?

text: 欢迎评论区和我互动，一起展望2025年。
en: Welcome to interact with me in the comments section, and look ahead to 2025 together.

text: 作者简介：赵默，公众号：赵默，2022最新代表作《跨越式成长思维》，通过真实的案例来分析当下非常关心的“乏力”“进退两难”“平衡”等问题，
en: Author bio: Mo Zhao; official account: Mo Zhao. Latest representative work of 2022, "Leapfrog Growth Mindset", which uses real cases to analyse issues of great current concern such as "lassitude", "being caught in a dilemma" and "balance",

text: 多角度深入挖掘个体隐藏的潜能，结合商业趋势，运用管理、经济、NLP心理、教练技术、生涯规划等知识和方法，给你提供接地气切实可行的一本好书，
en: It explores the hidden potential of the individual from multiple angles, combines business trends, and applies knowledge and methods such as management, economics, NLP psychology, coaching techniques and career planning to provide you with a down-to-earth and practical good book,

text: 京东当当搜索书名即可，前上市500强公司十年HRD,资深优势发展教练，美国全球BCC生涯认证教练，资深国家二级心理咨询师，
en: You can simply search for the book title on JD and Dangdang. Former HRD of ten years at a listed Fortune 500 company; senior strengths-development coach; US global BCC career-certified coach; senior nationally certified Level-2 psychological consultant,

text: 企业高管生涯领导力顾问，累积15年已帮助5200+企业CEO和高管，内外突破瓶颈，实现向上发展。
en: Corporate executive career-leadership consultant; over fifteen years, has helped more than 5,200 corporate CEOs and executives break through bottlenecks both internally and externally, achieving upward development.
